title: The Mathematics of Weight-Space Programming: Behavioral Optimality, Finite Preservation, and Transformers
read_level: full (main PDF, proofs skimmed; 1-page Supplementary_Results.pdf read on retry: FT-L reference, shared displacement optimization, observation-target checks)
metadata_mismatch: Corpus id 23933590 resolves to version record 23933591 (PDF DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23933591). Metadata title omits subtitle 'Behavioral Optimality, Finite Preservation, and Transformers'. Author is 'Miquel Noguer i Alonso' in metadata/Zenodo creators but 'Miquel Noguer Alonso' on the PDF. Metadata date 2026-11-04; Zenodo record and PDF say November 3, 2026.
why_wsp: Mathematical treatment of the editing problem behind WSP (constrained minimum-cost edits of a transformer's last MLP output matrix with exact preservation guarantees), solved by explicit algorithms rather than an LLM editor.
domain: transformer model editing (toy modular-arithmetic transformers; GPT-2 CounterFact factual edits)
editor: none (solver): closed-form constrained least squares, scalar convex optimization, interval QP, second-order cone programs, chord/Newton iterations
target: fifteen small 2-block transformers (residual width 32, vocabulary eight); GPT-2 (124M) and GPT-2 Medium (355M), last MLP output matrix only
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: edits restricted to the final MLP output matrix ('Only Wout is edited', Sec. 2.2); minimum-rank result: 'rank(∆W∗) = rank D, the smallest possible rank of any feasible edit' (Thm 2.1)

headline_results.claim: Behavioral optimization reduces edit norms on controlled models
headline_results.quote: behavioral optimization reduces median edit norms by 40.0%, 33.2%, and 34.0%

headline_results.claim: Gain vanishes for injective complete-logit readouts
headline_results.quote: this readout-nullspace gain vanishes for complete-logit targets when the centered readout is injective

headline_results.claim: Interval-QP improves held-out neighbor retention on GPT-2 vs exact-moment control
headline_results.quote: Its held-out neighbor retention exceeds the matched exact-moment control by 21.09 and 19.38 percentage points on 124M and 355M
Relative to exact-moment, paraphrase success changes by -3.91 and -4.69 points; mean test NLL changes by +0.0069 and +0.0019 nats.

headline_results.claim: Exactness of protected logits on controlled edits
headline_results.quote: maximum target-logit error is 3.19 × 10−12 , and protected-logit error for exact methods is 1.74 × 10−13

baselines_and_controls: unprotected/soft/exact edits with identity vs moment metrics, raw vs centered donor; on GPT-2: ROME-final, AlphaEdit-final (matched-location adaptations), exact-moment control, FT-L near-identity reference
runs_and_variance: Controlled: five seeds per model type, medians of 32 pairs ('The 480 pairs are not 480 independent model replications.'); GPT-2: 128 cases per checkpoint with 10,000-resample case bootstrap 95% intervals [16.88, 25.47] and [15.47, 23.44]
robustness_of_edits: Sequential edits tested on controlled models (protecting earlier target keys retains all eight targets); generation audit: interval-QP 'retains 95.7% of unrelated first tokens but only 72.3% of full eight-token greedy continuations'; no fine-tuning/quantization tests
verification: formal proofs (theorems on compatibility, exact protected-prefix lifting, margin intervals, Banach fixed-point certified correction radii) plus float64 numerical audits; authors note these are 'floating-point checks, not interval-arithmetic proofs'
memorization_vs_reasoning: n/a (no LLM editor; 'the numerical editors below are explicit algorithms, not tests of that autonomous capability')
limitations_stated: Full-matrix cone extension needs offset-sign condition and tested only on small fixtures; global theorem covers one observed target; sequential retention only on controlled models; earlier-layer certificates, multi-token rewrites, pretrained sequential edits and multi-billion-parameter models beyond evidence; preservation outside contracts must be measured.
code_or_data: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.23933591 (main PDF plus Supplementary_Results.pdf); paper states 'Source, raw results, checkpoints for the controlled models, and numerical audits accompany the paper' but no code URL found
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi, Teoh, Zhang, Khattab 2026 'Sparks of Weight-Space Programming' blog
ROME, MEMIT, EMMET, AlphaEdit, CrispEdit, MEND
notes_for_survey: Theory paper that reframes WSP editing as constrained optimization with exact preservation contracts on the final MLP; uses classical solvers, not an LLM. Relevant to B5 (non-LLM editors) and to verification: gives certificates for stated keys/margins but stresses broader retention stays empirical.
